note: Cases mirror the postgres module of orbital-compiler tests/host_effects_validation.rs (control_well_formed_calls_raise_none_of_the_postgres_codes, an_origin_outside_egress_or_of_the_wrong_scheme_is_refused, a_literal_statement_must_be_one_read_only_select, the_params_are_a_list_and_the_arity_is_four_to_six, the_options_are_closed_share_one_namespace_and_name_a_user) plus the key and cancelled cases of emit_config_validation.rs that reach a postgres call. Each case runs the whole chain: the operator shapes, the walk, the plan, and the answers of std-sql-select-guard and std-orb-emit-config (stubbed as their goldens pin them). declared_success_payload (EmitPayloadNotProduced) is another rule and is not mirrored.
